# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Role:** Conductor

## Appearance

Barney Pullen is a man who dresses in the standard uniform of a train conductor. He maintains a professional demeanor while managing the passengers and operations on board.

## Personality

Barney is pragmatic, dutiful, and accustomed to dealing with the mundane realities of railway transport. He prioritizes safety and routine on his train, though he can be flustered when unexpected or strange incidents disrupt his normal schedule.

## Traits

- Dutiful
- Practical

## Abilities

- Train management and operations

## Goals

- Maintain order and schedules on his train routes

## History

Barney Pullen works as a train conductor who encounters various travelers during his runs. He performs his routine duties of checking tickets and overseeing passenger safety on the rail line. His interactions with passengers often ground supernatural or unusual occurrences within the everyday reality of local transit.
